method: Join depth-chart player_id (gsis) to nflverse roster_2026. is_rookie iff rookie_year==season (fallback years_exp==0 or entry_year==season when rookie_year unset). draft_round from draft_picks when known; never invent from overall pick alone. Missing roster join → unclassified (is_rookie=false, draft_round=null).
notes: Season-engine season=2026 rookies are the 2026 draft class (rookie_year=2026), not 2025-class year-2 players (Jeanty/Ward/etc.).
Draft capital mild mean nudge only when draft_round is present.
